quotes: The goal came with controversy, originally being ruled out for the ball going out of play. VAR took several minutes to rule a sliver of the curvature of the ball was hanging over the line and hence in play.

In the final group match against Spain on 1 December, he came on as a half-time substitute for Yuto Nagatomo and assisted Ao Tanaka's winning goal in the 51st minute. The goal came with controversy, originally being ruled out for the ball going out of play. VAR took several minutes to rule a sliver of the curvature of the ball was hanging over the line and hence in play.
